lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. The arrangement consists of at least five horizontal rows, with the central rows exhibiting a higher spatial frequency of spots (~10-12 pixels apart) compared to the dorsal-most row (~20-25 pixels apart).
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the primary blobs to form a structured lattice. The intensity of these vertical bands is lower than the central blobs but significantly higher than the dark-blue background inter-spaces.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper lateral flank. These features follow a linear trajectory roughly parallel to the dorsal midline, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from RGB(120, 180, 210) on the upper ridge to RGB(20, 60, 100) in the immediate ventral shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs. Approximately 4-6 distinct spots are visible, concentrated primarily along the leading edge and mid-section of the fin silhouette.
